The usage of Rte_ActivatingEvent is optional and defined in [SWS_Rte_08051]. The Memory Mapping macros could wrap several Entry Point Prototype if these are referring to the same swAddrMethod . If RunnableEntity does not refer a swAd- drMethod the <sadm> is set to default CODE .
